ingredients.name: Gentle pH-Balanced (5.5) Scalp Cleanser
ingredients.purpose: Maintains natural acid mantle and protects beneficial scalp microbiome without stripping essential lipids.

ingredients.name: Hyaluronic Acid & Panthenol Hydration Serum
ingredients.purpose: Delivers lightweight humectant hydration to support hair follicle vitality and stratum corneum elasticity.

ingredients.name: Niacinamide (2%) Scalp Antioxidant Tonic
ingredients.purpose: Strengthens epidermal barrier ceramides and defends against urban PM2.5 particulate oxidants.

lifestyle: Maintain current balanced hair care cadence and adequate dietary hydration and protein.
Perform a routine 30-day baseline scan to track longitudinal follicle density and seasonal shifts.
Use a shower filter if traveling through hard borewell water regions to prevent mineral deposit buildup.

ingredients.name: Salicylic Acid (0.5% - 1.0%) Scalp Solution
ingredients.purpose: Gently loosens dry, adherent stratum corneum flakes.

ingredients.name: Squalane / Ceramide Scalp Barrier Oil
ingredients.purpose: Replenishes essential epidermal intercellular lipids.

ingredients.name: EDTA Chelating Cleanser
ingredients.purpose: Binds and removes calcium and magnesium mineral deposits caused by hard tap water.

lifestyle: If exposed to hard tap/borewell water, consider using an attachable tap or shower filter.
Reduce washing frequency to avoid stripping the natural acid mantle.

ingredients.name: Ketoconazole 2% or Selenium Sulfide 2.5% Wash
ingredients.frequency: 2x per week (leave on scalp for 5 minutes prior to rinsing)
ingredients.purpose: Inhibits Malassezia fungal proliferation and reduces inflammatory cytokine release.

ingredients.name: Zinc Pyrithione (1%) or Piroctone Olamine Cleanser
ingredients.purpose: Maintains antimicrobial suppression between primary active washes.

ingredients.name: Salicylic Acid 2% Scalp Solution
ingredients.purpose: Breaks down oily follicular plaques and sebum plugs.

lifestyle: Ensure hair and scalp are thoroughly dried after washing; do not sleep with damp hair.
Avoid applying heavy plant oils (e.g., pure coconut or olive oil) directly to active flare-ups, as lipids can nourish Malassezia species.

ingredients.name: Non-Irritating Peptide / Caffeine Scalp Serum
ingredients.purpose: Provides gentle micro-environmental support while awaiting clinical consultation.

lifestyle: Avoid mechanical traction, aggressive brushing, or tight hair styling.
Consult a certified dermatologist promptly for dermoscopy, trichoscopy, and formal assessment.

ingredients.name: Hypochlorous Acid Scalp Spray or Dilute Benzoyl Peroxide (2.5%) Wash
ingredients.purpose: Reduces surface bacterial colonization.

lifestyle: Do not squeeze, pick, or mechanically scratch inflamed follicular bumps.
Launder pillowcases frequently in warm water.
Seek evaluation from a dermatologist for appropriate clinical management.

ingredients.name: Botanical Rosemary & Peptide Scalp Tonic
ingredients.purpose: Provides supportive antioxidant and peptide conditioning for the scalp micro-environment; discuss medical interventions directly with a certified dermatologist.

ingredients.name: Niacinamide (2%) & Caffeine Scalp Serum
ingredients.purpose: Supports localized epidermal micro-circulation and skin barrier strength.

ingredients.name: Gentle Volumizing / Densifying Cleanser
ingredients.purpose: Removes sebum buildup around follicular ostia without stripping moisture from delicate hair shafts.

lifestyle: Consult a certified dermatologist or trichologist for trichoscopy assessment and individualized management plans.
Avoid hairstyles causing excessive physical tension (traction) that add mechanical stress to miniaturizing follicles.
Track visual pattern progression with standardized monthly parting photos under consistent lighting.

ingredients.name: Salicylic Acid / Keratolytic Scalp Solution
ingredients.frequency: 1-2x per week as directed by physician
ingredients.purpose: Helps soften and gently loosen thick, adherent hyperkeratotic surface scales.

ingredients.name: Ceramide & Colloidal Oat Soothing Emulsion
ingredients.purpose: Relieves scalp dryness and discomfort while supporting epidermal barrier integrity.

ingredients.name: Gentle Non-Medicated Scalp Cleanser
ingredients.purpose: Cleanses without aggravating inflamed plaque margins or causing mechanical irritation.

lifestyle: Consult a dermatologist for formal evaluation, as scalp plaque conditions typically require targeted prescription topical therapies.
Avoid forcibly picking, scratching, or peeling thick plaques, which can trigger localized inflammation (Koebner response).
Use lukewarm water rather than hot water when washing hair to minimize epidermal irritation and vascular erythema.

ingredients.name: Fragrance-Free Gentle Scalp Cleanser
ingredients.purpose: Removes residue without adding potential irritants.

ingredients.name: Ceramide & Colloidal Oat Soothing Emulsion
ingredients.purpose: Supports the skin barrier while the trigger is removed.

lifestyle: Pause new hair dyes, shampoos, styling products or oils introduced in the last few weeks.
Rinse hair thoroughly with lukewarm water and avoid scratching the area.
See a dermatologist if redness, swelling or itching persists beyond 1-2 weeks.

ingredients.name: Pharmacist-Recommended Anti-Lice Treatment
ingredients.frequency: As directed by the pharmacist or physician
ingredients.purpose: Treatment choice and repeat timing depend on local guidance and resistance; do not self-select without advice.

lifestyle: Check for live lice or nits close to the scalp using a fine-toothed comb.
Wash bedding, hats and combs in hot water and avoid sharing them.
Check close contacts and seek advice from a pharmacist or doctor.

ingredients.name: Gentle Non-Medicated Scalp Cleanser
ingredients.purpose: Avoids aggravating inflamed skin while awaiting clinical assessment.

lifestyle: Book a dermatologist appointment soon; diagnosis usually needs examination and sometimes a biopsy.
Avoid scratching, tight hairstyles and harsh chemical treatments.
Take dated photos of the area to show the clinician.

ingredients.name: Gentle Daily Scalp Cleanser
ingredients.purpose: Maintains scalp hygiene without adding mechanical stress.

lifestyle: Think back 2-3 months for triggers such as illness, major stress, childbirth or rapid weight change.
Discuss blood tests (serum ferritin, vitamin D, TSH) with a physician.
Maintain adequate protein and iron intake and re-check in 6-8 weeks; see a dermatologist if shedding continues.

ingredients.name: Gentle Non-Medicated Scalp Cleanser
ingredients.purpose: Keeps the area clean until a clinician confirms the diagnosis; over-the-counter products alone are usually not sufficient.

lifestyle: See a doctor or dermatologist promptly; a scalp scraping or culture is often needed to confirm.
Do not share combs, hats, towels or pillows; it can spread to others.
Wash bedding and hair tools in hot water.

disclaimer: This assessment is for informational and educational purposes only and suggests potential scalp care routines. It does not constitute medical diagnosis, formal medical advice, or treatment. If symptoms persist, cause discomfort, or worsen, please consult a certified dermatologist.
